name: Tips Music Ltd
about:
Tips Industries Limited, incorporated in 1996, is engaged in the business of Production and Distribution of motion Pictures and acquisition and exploitation of Music of Rights. 
The co is also a leading producer of Punjabi films in the country. [1][2]
keyPoints:
Collection[1]
The co has a large music library with a collection of over 30,000 songs across various genres and regional languages. The co has produced and released around 40 Hindi films in the past 20 years and also sells the theatrical, satellite, and various other rights to distributors, broadcasters, etc.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 70.3% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 77.0%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 40.9%
cons: Stock is trading at 25.4 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -10.8%
Working capital days have increased from 7.75 days to 64.1 days
